entries.title: Product Design Intern (f/m/d) M A R C H 2 0 2 6 – A U G U S T 2 0 2 6 Are you passionate about creating design that inspires? At Noto, we focus on bringing product experiences to life. Based in a beautiful old factory near Cologne, we’re a team of 15 creatives who love to challenge conventions and push design boundaries. Why intern with us? 🌟Inspire & be inspired: From ideation to prototyping, explore trends and tools that drive product excellence. 🚀Hands-on experience: With 20+ years of expertise, you’ll contribute to real projects alongside experienced designers. 🤝Collaborative environment: Work in an open, diverse environment where your ideas truly matter. 💡Creative impact: Design products that improve how people live, work and interact. 🏓Community & fun: Enjoy team lunches from our in-house chef, table tennis matches and fun after-work activities. What you’ll do: • Be part of the full Noto process, from research to final concept. • Identify user needs, generate insights and explore opportunities. • Develop ideas through sketches, CAD models, and renderings. • Build prototypes in our workshop and bring concepts to life. • Help craft product stories that reflect brand identity and user experience. What we’re looking for: • You’re enrolled in a design program (mandatory internship). • You think differently, challenge norms and love creating the unexpected. • You’re skilled in visualizing and communicating, with strong proficiency in Adobe CC, CAD and rendering. • You’re confident in spoken and written English and comfortable preparing presentations. • A positive team player who enjoys working collaboratively and pro actively helps to move things forward. • Bonus points for creative side skills like photography, video or something entirely unexpected. Be part of a team that balances excellence with passion, creating designs that are not only visually intriguing but also aim to make a positive impact in the world! Join our creative journey as a Product Design Intern. Send us your portfolio - we’re excited to meet you! ❗Important: The internship must be a mandatory part of your academic program, we will need a written document from your university. Application timeline is from November until December 7th Interviews will be held December 8th until December 19th Decisions will be made before christmas. Noto GmbH 📩 J O B S @ N O T O .
